chunks: It is narrated from Mu‘āwiyah ibn ‘Ammār, who said:
Abū ‘Abdillāh عليه السلام said: “There is no harm in completing all the rites without wudu (ablution), except the tawaf of the House; and wudu (ablution) is better.”

key_terms.الْمَنَاسِكَ: the ritual acts and rites of hajj
key_terms.بِالْبَيْتِ: the Sacred House, meaning the Ka‘bah
key_terms.وُضُوءٍ: ritual ablution required for certain acts of worship

ai.seo_question: Is wudu required for all hajj rites or only for tawaf?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the rites of hajj. It states that the various manasik may be performed without wudu (ablution), except for tawaf around the Ka‘bah, while also affirming that maintaining wudu (ablution) is superior.
